Here are the key facts I was able to find about Federico Molinari, the Italian gymnast:

- Federico Molinari is an Italian artistic gymnast. He competes for the Italian national gymnastics team.

- He has competed in multiple European and World Gymnastics Championships. 

- At the 2016 European Men's Artistic Gymnastics Championships, Molinari won a silver medal on the parallel bars.

- At the 2017 World Artistic Gymnastics Championships, Molinari won a bronze medal on the parallel bars.

- Molinari represented Italy at the 2016 Summer Olympics in Rio de Janeiro, where he competed in artistic gymnastics events.

- In addition to his success on the parallel bars, Molinari is considered a strong all-around gymnast, capable of performing well in multiple gymnastics disciplines.

- Molinari is one of the top Italian male gymnasts of the 2010s, helping establish Italy as a strong force in men's artistic gymnastics alongside other top Italian gymnasts.
